recent.text: Maybe the Vikings mean this, maybe they don't. Whatever. What I do know: It's not cheap to base an entire team+support ops away for an entire week. The 49ers have fully committed to replicating HQ elsewhere. The AF Academy move required a BIG investment from the organization
